name: Iku Mono e no Komoriuta
source:
A small island in the South Sea a few hours away from Honshu by boat on a good weather.
Population has deteriorated greatly in recent years, so the last school on the island is about to be closed.
Main character returns to this dying island to fulfill his promise given to the loved one...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
南海的一个小岛，天气好的时候，距离本州岛只有几个小时的船程。
近年来人口严重恶化，岛上最后一所学校即将关闭。
主角回到这座垂死的岛屿，履行对所爱之人的承诺……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-october-2003-lovers-koi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
